definitions: To stop trying to do something, either because it is too difficult or because you have failed.
To stop doing or having something, especially something that you do regularly.
To allow yourself to be arrested or captured by the police or enemy.
To stop doing a job or activity.
examples: I give up, I can't solve this puzzle.
She gave up smoking last year.
The criminals decided to give up to the authorities.
He gave up his position as CEO.
pastTenses: gave up (past simple), given up (past perfect)
